g.text: Lesson 1: project test on the engine (Identify, Project experiment)
Review project test → Confirm and start; Abort test
review: the identity of the campaign (loop revision, settings, declared 120.1 s, scenario)
start: the same identity, or refused; journaled before dispatch
recording with the program revision; restoration confirmed by an unforced scan
answer: kept recording and its samples, restoration, and the fit or its note
P1.ExperimentEnabled (%MX24.0, BOOL): TRUE at start, FALSE at the end
the selected signals recorded with the program revision
open at 60 s, closed at 90 s
Disabled, invalid or aborted: compressor OFF and door closed.
Restart simulator for a matching thermal initial state.
No activation-relative runtime event API is introduced.
Normal completion restores the activation without asserting an abort.
Lesson 1 declares no abort binding, so an abort or a failed termination
A fit that the recording cannot support is the test's note: the study keeps
the recording and no model, and its current model stays as it was (B3.7).
review, then start with the same identity
Abort test: cancel of that operation
kept recording and samples; the fit, or its refusal as the note
activation TRUE at start; recording of the selected signals
restoration: activation FALSE, confirmed by an unforced scan
%QL16 DoorCommand: 1 while the door is open
%QL8 SurroundingsCommand: 4 °C, 6 °C while the door is open
recorded samples, with the program revision
